# harness_platform_sso_saml (Data Source)

Data source for retrieving a SAML SSO configuration of a Harness account. The SAML metadata XML and the Azure client secret are not returned by the API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "harness_platform_sso_saml" "example" {
  identifier = "<saml_sso_identifier>"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identifier` (String) Unique identifier of the SAML SSO configuration.

### Read-Only

- `authentication_enabled` (Boolean) Whether login via this SAML configuration is enabled.
- `authorization_enabled` (Boolean) Whether group-based authorization is enabled.
- `client_id` (String) Optional clientId for Azure SSO.
- `display_name` (String) Display name of the SAML SSO configuration.
- `entity_identifier` (String) Entity identifier of the SAML service provider.
- `friendly_saml_name` (String) Friendly name of the app on the SAML SSO provider end in Harness.
- `group_membership_attr` (String) Attribute in the SAML assertion containing the user's group memberships.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `jit_enabled` (Boolean) Whether Just in time user provisioning is enabled.
- `jit_validation_key` (String) Optional key to match in the SAML assertion for Just in time user provisioning.
- `jit_validation_value` (String) Optional value to match in the SAML assertion for Just in time user provisioning.
- `logout_url` (String) Logout URL of the SAML identity provider.
- `origin` (String) Origin URL derived from the uploaded SAML metadata.
- `saml_provider_type` (String) SAML provider type.
